feeds.title: Forcetalks Blog » Salesforce Marketing Cloud
feeds.description: Go through an amazing collection of Salesforce blogs written by Salesforce Experts to help developers, admins, and consultants. Forcetalks was founded in 2016 as a platform to explore Salesforce at all levels where users can learn, collaborate, and bring new perspectives and useful insights to the Salesforce Ohana.

feeds.title: The Spot
feeds.description: View all of the latest blog posts on The Spot for Pardot, or browse resources by category to find the marketing automation answers you need. The Spot is more than a blog. It's a community to collaborate with and learn from marketers and Salesforce pros who have been there, seen it, and fixed it. You'll find resources for all the martech challenges - whether you're getting started or need expert advice for advanced integrations.

feeds.title: Unfetteredmarketing Blog
feeds.description: Unfetteredmarketing Blog is a collection of random thoughts on how people, places and things in our fascinating world connect to sales and marketing, and what we can learn from it. My goal in launching UnFettered Marketing is to help B2B manufacturing companies identify and remove barriers that are holding back sales and marketing success. Most importantly, more than advising, I help you execute on these opportunities.

feeds.title: Pardot School
feeds.description: Pardot School brings together Pardot resources from around the world to share the knowledge and expertise to those trying to learn and upskill on Salesforce Pardot. We curate Pardot resources, experts, trainings, and articles into one place to upskill marketing automation professionals.

feeds.title: Greenkey News
feeds.description: Pardot expert, advisor Jen Kazin teaches marketers how to improve and measure their current marketing efforts with Pardot and Salesforce. Find all the answers to your questions on salesforce, Pardot, marketing and more!

feeds.title: CloudKettle Blog
feeds.description: This blog is dedicated to sharing actionable insight on Salesforce security best practices, Salesforce optimization for enterprises and more. CloudKettle helps SaaS companies improve their Sales, Marketing and Customer Support activities by leveraging Salesforce and integrated tools.

feeds.title: DESelect Blog
feeds.description: DESelect are a Belgium-based Salesforce AppExchange ISV that developed an easy, drag-and-drop interface for data segmentation in Marketing Cloud. Naturally, their content revolves around segmentation and data models, but you will find plenty of tutorials and use cases.

feeds.title: Salesforce Ben » Marketers
feeds.description: Salesforce Ben is the leading site for Salesforce professionals looking to advance their careers. Since 2014, we have shared trusted, engaging content to help our readers stay up to date with the latest Salesforce news, releases, certifications, and acquisitions, as well as technical guides and tutorials.

feeds.title: Pardot Geeks
feeds.description: There are lots of resources out there if you are interested in learning Pardot. The Pardot community is full of folks who are happy to help. Check out some of these great community resources to get you started. Learn best practices, tricks and hacks from thought leaders and maximize your B2B Marketing.

feeds.title: sfmarketing.cloud
feeds.description: Zuzanna Jarczynska is a Salesforce MVP and a Salesforce Marketing Cloud Solution Architect at Deloitte Digital. This blog is to share knowledge about AMPscript, SQL, Server-Side JavaScript, Marketing Cloud APIs and other technical aspects of working with Salesforce Marketing Cloud.

feeds.title: Salesforce Blog » Marketing Cloud
feeds.description: Salesforce has sought to change the world for the better through technology that builds stronger relationships. Between companies and their customers. Between employees and far-flung teams. Between governments and their citizens. Between people who want to make a difference. Our marketing cloud blog features all the latest news, insights, features and more!
